condition: In the streaming engine, a multi-column unique()/n_unique() inside group_by().agg() is lowered to one group-by per column, re-reading the source each time, so it runs much slower than in-memory and can spill a lot to disk.
workaround: Use pl.col(VALS).implode(maintain_order=False).list.eval(pl.element().unique(maintain_order=False)) in the agg. This keeps all values in memory, though.
